user_story: As a guest, I want to see all my bookings so that I can review my reservations.

positive.title: Guest sees all bookings when logged in
steps: Click on the 'Bookings' tab or section
View the list of bookings presented
positive.expected_result: All bookings for the logged-in guest account are displayed in a list

negative.title: Bookings are not displayed without logging in
steps: Attempt to access the 'Bookings' section without logging in
negative.expected_result: User is prompted to log in with a message like 'Please log in to view your bookings'

edge.title: Guest with zero bookings sees appropriate message
steps: Log in with guest credentials that have no bookings
edge.expected_result: A message like 'You have no bookings at this time' is displayed instead of a list
